answer_1.quote: We investigate user interactions with an AI system, focusing on confidence calibration and trust, not on natural‑language generation tasks.

answer_2.quote: We rely on a proxy that describes a manifestation of trust rather than using automatic metrics to evaluate generated outputs.

answer_3.quote: We simulate an AI system that outputs predictions and confidences; no language model is used after generation to judge the outputs.

answer_4.quote: Participants were recruited to evaluate the AI system’s confidence, but no human evaluation of generated textual outputs was conducted.
